title: Construction of CeCux-BTC/CN S-type heterojunctions and photocatalytic CO2 reduction to CO and CH4
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8541-8552
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05721J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hui Zhang, Yi Hui Sun, Sheng Li An, Rui Hua Guo, Rui Fen Wang, Yu Wei Ma
Bimetallic organic framework/g-C3N4 heterostructures were synthesized solvothermally using cerium nitrate, urea and H3BTC. Ce-BTC microrods and Cu-doped microspheres can form beneficial MOF materials to improve photocatalytic CO2 reduction.
